title: Q6
description:
“But now we do not yet see all things put under him. But we see Jesus.”
Read: Psa 8:5–6, Psa 110:1, Heb 1:13
a) In 2:8 “him” is man, from Psa 8. In 2:9 Hebrews names Jesus. What does the psalm's picture of man's lost dominion bring forward about why Jesus is the one in whom it is now seen?
b) Psa 8:5 reads “a little lower than the angels.” Hebrews' Greek can also mean “for a little while lower.” What does that let Hebrews say about the Son's incarnation and death?
